NativeWind maps supported Tailwind-style utility classes to React Native styling. It requires setup
appropriate to its version and platform; browser-only CSS is not automatically supported.
Tailwind වJගේ className භාවිතJයන් mobile UI style කරන්න පුළුවන්. හුම web CSS property
